case_name: SMT. ANANYA DEY and ANR. v. The Union Of India And 6 Ors.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT. ANANYA DEY and ANR., wife and daughter of late Kajal Chandra Dey@Kajal Dey
parties.respondent_defendant: The Union Of India, Ministry of Home Affairs, and others

facts_of_case: Petitioners prayed for authorization of family pension and other pensionery benefits in respect of services rendered by their father/husband, late Kajal Chandra Dey@Kajal Dey, with Indian Air Force and Punjab National Bank.

legal_principles.principle: A child born out of a void and voidable marriage is considered a legitimate child.
legal_principles.held: Further, he has placed reliance on the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court rendered in the case of Rameshwari Devi Vs. State of Bihar and Others, reported in AIR (2000) SC 735.
cited_cases: Rameshwari Devi Vs. State of Bihar and Others, (2000) SC 735

legal_principles.principle: A declaratory decree can be used to draw a presumption about the death of an individual.
legal_principles.held: It was further projected that basing on the said declaratory decree, Shila Dey had drawn the pension and pensionery benefits available on account of the services rendered by Kajal Chandra Dey.

outcome.final_order: Authorization of family pension and other pensionery benefits in respect of services rendered by their father/husband, late Kajal Chandra Dey@Kajal Dey.
